findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The manual ware washing station was set up in the incorrect order. The sinks were as followed: wash, sanitize, rinse. The correct setup was discussed with the owner to ensure that dishes are getting cleaned properly. Sanitation should always be the last step of cleaning to be sure that the correct contact times are being met.
findings.citation_text: 4-703.11(A) Hot Water and Chemical. After being cleaned, equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be sanitized in: (A) Hot water manual operations by immersion for at least 30 seconds and as specified under § 4-501.111.

findings.title: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events.
findings.comment: On arrival there is not a procedure available for cleaning up vomit/diarrheal events. A new copy of the procedure given by this department was distributed to correct.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored and used.
findings.comment: On arrival the CL based sanitizer in the unit are far to strong for safe use around food. The solution was diluted during this inspection to acceptable levels to correct.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment: Observed no sanitizer solution available for use. Sanitizer solution was made during inspection and tested at 200 ppm Cl-
